premises.text: Existing water heaters waste water, are hard to temperature-control, inefficient, and fail when heating elements get hot
premises.evidence_span: Existing hot water heating technology doesn't save water. It's difficult to control the temperature. It's not energy efficient and the things inside that get really hot to heat the water break when they get really hot

premises.text: Electronic controls heat water instantly via water's own resistance without heating elements or burners
premises.evidence_span: using electronic controls and the natural resistance of the water itself to heat the water instantly without any heating elements or burners

premises.text: Wi-Fi iOS controls enable temperature presets, usage reports, and utility peak-demand power limits
premises.evidence_span: our electronic controls are natural for Wi-Fi connectivity. So through our iOS app on the front page, you can actually adjust temperature settings and presets

premises.text: Model 1 can augment existing heaters as booster, extender, or turbocharger applications

premises.text: Booster, extender, and turbocharger create a new retrofit market beyond replacement heaters
premises.evidence_span: these three new applications, we've created a whole brand new market
